children: Nvidia's results should help ease some of the concerns created by its recent leadership turmoil, says Brian Colello at Morningstar. Shipments haven't slipped, and Morningstar remains confident in the AI infrastructure buildout. Investors will now look for Nvidia to show that it can continue executing without Jensen Huang. "We're at a point of peak uncertainty," the analyst says. Huang's departure could create some near-term disruption but a credible succession plan should go a long way toward steadying the ship, Colello says. The next CEO has big shoes to fill but Nvidia's long-term opportunity doesn't hinge on one person, he adds. While there are risks around policy, international sales, and hyperscalers developing their own chips, Colello reckons Nvidia will remain an important player. (fabiana.negrinochoa@wsj.com)
